patch:
diff --git a/evals/tasks/05-duplicate-orders/fixture/queries.py b/evals/tasks/05-duplicate-orders/fixture/queries.py
index 55fa844..732136e 100644
--- a/evals/tasks/05-duplicate-orders/fixture/queries.py
+++ b/evals/tasks/05-duplicate-orders/fixture/queries.py
@@ -1,11 +1,10 @@
-from store import CUSTOMERS, ORDERS
+from store import ORDERS
 
 
 def orders_for_customer(customer):
     """All orders belonging to `customer`."""
     rows = []
     for order in ORDERS:
-        owner = next(c for c in CUSTOMERS if c["id"] == order["customer_id"])
-        if owner["name"] == customer["name"]:
+        if order["customer_id"] == customer["id"]:
             rows.append(order)
     return rows
verification: 1) Reproduced on the unmodified fixture: report dump showed 6 lines (101/102 each twice, cross-billed between the two Acme customers), total 290. 2) After fix: run_tests.py -> 'visible tests passed'. 3) Re-inspected report: 4 lines, total 165. 4) git status --short -> only queries.py changed.
cause: orders_for_customer associated orders with customers via the non-unique name field; both Acme customers matched every Acme order, duplicating lines and billing customers for orders they never placed. Fix attributes each order to exactly one customer via order['customer_id'] == customer['id'].
